name: kannaka-cannon
description: Kannaka Cannon — AI video intelligence for the constellation. A 22-stage analysis pipeline + MCP server (54 `clipcannon_*` tools) that ingests any clip, decomposes it into stems (scene/motion/speech/music/faces/OCR), folds them into the HRM, and exposes editing, rendering, voice-cloning, and lip-sync avatar tools. Skill teaches Claude how to register the clipcannon MCP server and run the ingest → understand → edit → render → voice/avatar workflow.
